the-twisted.name: The Twisted
the-twisted.description: Suitcase Deadlift, Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift, Romanian Deadlift, Single-Arm Clean, Single-Arm Press, Single-Arm Thruster — three reps each, the same six-step twist every round. Five rounds, ninety seconds between each.

the-descent.name: The Descent
the-descent.description: Long Cycle climbs one rep at a time while Renegade gives one back, rung after rung, until the tenth rung hands the whole weight to Long Cycle alone. Nothing repeats. Nothing eases.

the-rite.name: The Rite
the-rite.description: The chain first, whole — jerk into snatch into clean into swing, three times over. Then it is taken apart, each piece performed alone, three reps at a time. Then it is given back. Five rounds, three minutes between each, to decide whether repetition is practice or something else.

labyrinth-ladder.name: The Labyrinth Ladder
labyrinth-ladder.description: A 1-10-1 ladder on two lifts, nothing else. Choose your weight, then finish without skipping a single rep — the Minotaur does not forgive shortcuts.

abyss-carry.name: The Abyss Carry
abyss-carry.description: Five rounds, the same weight the whole way through. Never put the kettlebells down during the carry — carry the weight, or let it carry you.

iron-ascent.name: The Iron Ascent
iron-ascent.description: Three phases, three different demands — double-bell volume, then single-arm control, then double-bell precision. The Behemoth respects control, not speed.

everlasting-cycle.name: The Everlasting Cycle
everlasting-cycle.description: Five rounds of continuous movement. Never fight one exercise — fight the entire round. The Hydra wins when you focus on only one head.

web-of-motion.name: The Web of Motion
web-of-motion.description: Five rounds, one continuous thread. Never lose your rhythm — break it, and the web closes.

the-final-trial.name: The Final Trial
the-final-trial.description: One complete round from every monster you have already conquered, in order, with rest between each. There is no second attempt within the hunt — only forward.

hell-dive.name: Hell-Dive
hell-dive.description: Three moves, five rounds, no time to think. Swing, snatch, thruster — hit it hard and get out before it hits back.

atlas-chain.name: The Sovereign's Chain
atlas-chain.description: The full chain first — squat, press, clean, push press, row, one rep each — five times through without a break. Then every movement answers alone, five reps at a time, with nothing left to carry it.

ember-trial.name: The Ember Trial
ember-trial.description: Two rounds through the fire, then thirty reps with nothing left in the tank. The carry is the easy part.

endless-grind.name: The Endless Grind
endless-grind.description: Five rounds that never repeat the same shape twice — two bells, then one, then both hands trading off. Grit is not a burst. It is twenty-five minutes of not stopping.

final-second.name: The Final Second
final-second.description: Five exercises, one minute each, four times through. The window does not wait for the last rep.

mirror-trial.name: The Mirror Trial
mirror-trial.description: Left side, then right — the same thirty seconds of work, twice over, five times through. No side gets to skip its turn.

twin-assault.name: The Twin Assault
twin-assault.description: One head from above, one from the ground. Five rounds each, and neither head is the easy one.

unbroken-cycle.name: The Unbroken Cycle
unbroken-cycle.description: Left hand first — three lifts, each one starting back on the ground. Then the right hand rises to the same debt. Ten sides in all, a minute to recover between each: what falls must be raised again, on both sides, before it's over.

twin-engine.name: The Twin Engine
twin-engine.description: One side, then the other, then both bells together — nothing here stays unilateral or bilateral long enough to get comfortable. Five rounds, every pattern kettlebells know.

living-current.name: The Unbroken Chain
living-current.description: Left hand runs the full chain — swing, clean, lunge, jerk, thruster, snatch — five times without setting the bell down. Then the right hand takes on the same chain, five times more. Five rounds, both hands, no gap anywhere inside the chain itself.

iron-descent.name: The Risen
iron-descent.description: Deadlift it off the floor, pull it up, clean it into a push, thruster it, snatch it — the whole chain, twice through. Then every movement is made to answer alone, two reps each, with nothing left to carry it. The floor does not stay empty long.

war-engine.name: The Breaking
war-engine.description: Swing, jerk, pull, recover — fifteen times through with no wasted motion. No single round is hard. Round fifteen is a different question.

endless-spiral.name: The Wraith
endless-spiral.description: Snatch, overhead lunge, jerk, windmill, swing — one hand completes the full chain, then the other answers for the same current. The danger was never one movement. It's losing the chain in the moment it changes hands.

mammoth-emom.name: Mammoth Complex
mammoth-emom.description: An EMOM complex — five kettlebell movements against a three-minute clock, five rounds. Whatever time is left after the work is yours; the next minute starts whether you're ready or not.

basilisk-confrontation.name: Basilisk Confrontation
basilisk-confrontation.description: PROVISIONAL PRESCRIPTION — the movement sequence below is locked, but the round count, rest, and overall format (fixed rounds, EMOM, or time-capped) have not been finalized and are pending physical testing. Rounds/rest/roundBonusDamage/targetTimeSeconds here are a reasonable placeholder only — see PROJECT_CONTEXT.md for what to change once a final prescription is set. Burpee, then Clean → Jerk. Deadlift, then Clean → Jerk again. Deep Snatch, then Clean → Jerk a third time. The same confrontation, three times a round, with more fatigue in your hands each time you arrive at it.
